decision: reconstruct 6.20 keyboard, startup menu and shell option paths
changes: Use BootTicks for startup delay and recognize alternate F5/F8 scan codes.
Restore clean-boot option flags in keyboard and menu paths; remove target-absent menu exit instruction.
Implement and export shell option /D and /Y interfaces needed by sysinit1.
limitations: The 12-byte module placement difference and final relocation values require preceding module reconstruction; generated messages and final IO.SYS equality remain unresolved. Reconstructed symbol names may differ from Microsoft originals.
